gloss: fish meat; fish flesh (as food product)

definitions.gloss: the flesh of fish, considered as a food ingredient — especially used as a generic or categorical term, or in processed-food names
definitions.explanation: A slightly technical or categorical word for fish as meat, in contrast to {肉|にく} when it refers to livestock meat. Commonly seen on food labels and in processed-food names like {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージ (fish sausage) or {魚肉|ぎょにく}ハム. Much less common in everyday cooking speech, where people simply say {魚|さかな}.

examples.japanese: {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ソーセージ→ソーセージ：11027_sooseeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
{魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高|たか}タンパク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧だ。
examples.english: Fish meat is high in protein and low in calories.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{練|ね}り{物|もの}→練り物：20035_nerimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{主|しゅ}⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This processed product is made primarily from fish meat.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ソーセージ→ソーセージ：11027_sooseeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a kid, fish sausages were often in my lunchbox.

notes:
Compound of {魚|ぎょ} ("fish") + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ ("meat, flesh"). Treats fish as a category of meat. The word is somewhat technical and appears more in food-industry, nutritional, and processed-product contexts than in everyday speech.

USAGE:
- In everyday conversation, people normally say ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ when talking about eating fish — not {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- Extremely common as the first half of compound product names: {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ソーセージ→ソーセージ：11027_sooseeji⟧, {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ハム→ハム：09755_hamu⟧, {魚肉|ぎょにく}{練製品|ねりせいひん} (fish paste products).
- Used in nutrition and cooking-science discussions to classify food types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ソーセージ→ソーセージ：11027_sooseeji⟧: fish sausage
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦ハム→ハム：09755_hamu⟧: fish ham
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}⟦{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}→加工品：16489_kakouhin⟧: processed fish products
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}{練製品|ねりせいひん}: fish paste products (kamaboko, chikuwa, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧: fish — the everyday word, used whether alive, raw, or cooked.
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: meat — typically livestock meat (beef, pork, chicken); contrasts with {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- {畜肉|ちくにく}: livestock meat — the technical counterpart to {魚肉|ぎょにく}.
- ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧/⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧: white-fleshed / red-fleshed (fish) — describe types of fish flesh.
